# Engin Bayrak

> Engin Bayrak (b. 12 December 1979, Germany) is a Turkish composer, musician and writer known for film, TV series and theatre scores. He writes and performs his own songs, blending Balkan, Turkish music, rock, world and electronica. This is his official website (bilingual: Turkish / English).

## Key facts
- Roles: composer, musician, writer, arranger, vocalist, music director
- Education: BSc Mathematics, Ege University (İzmir); studied Classical Turkish Music (makam & composition)
- Genres: pop, rock, world, electronica, Turkish music, jazz
- Active since 1998; 80+ staged projects (films, TV, documentaries, advertisements, theatre, albums)
- Contact: engin@enginbayrak.com

## Notable works
- Film score: "İncir Reçeli" (2011) — composed themes; wrote and performed Turkish & English songs
- TV series: "Yedi Güzel Adam" (2014–2015, 39 episodes) — all themes and the title song
- Albums/singles: Kayboldum (2025), Voyage to Dreams (2020), Sekerat (2020), Moonlight (2011), Electra Symphony (2006, released in Japan)
- Contributions: "Ey Aşk" — Halil Sezai (2013, composer/lyricist/arranger); "Sır" — Ayfer Vardar (2019, arranger)
